label: credential phishing
email:
From: PAYPAL Security <service@paypa1-secure.com>
To: customer@example.com
Subject: URGENT: Your account has been limited

Dear Valued Customer,

We have detected unusual activity on your account. Your account access has
been LIMITED until you verify your information.

You must confirm your identity within 24 hours or your account will be
permanently suspended and your funds forfeited.

Click here to restore access: http://paypa1-secure.com/verify/login.php

Please have your password and the card number on file ready.

Sincerely,
PAYPAL Security Team
verdict: Almost certainly a phishing attempt impersonating PayPal, given the mismatched domain and urgent account verification request.

highlights.description: sender domain 'paypa1-secure.com' imitates 'PAYPAL' using character substitution
sender domain 'paypa1-secure.com' imitates 'PAYPAL' using character substitution
uses urgency to pressure the reader
highlights.quote: You must confirm your identity within 24 hours or your account will be permanently suspended

highlights.description: links point somewhere other than where they claim
asks for credentials or personal data
highlights.quote: Please have your password and the card number on file ready.

label: lookalike domain, model missed it

From: WeTransfer <noreply@we-transfer.com>
To: jose@example.com
Subject: you just received files via WeTransfer

You have received 3 files, 14 MB in total. They will be deleted on 05 Oct.

Download your Docs here.

To make sure our emails arrive, please add noreply@wetransfer.com to your
contacts.
verdict: This email appears to be a legitimate notification from WeTransfer regarding file transfer, with no indicators of phishing.

highlights.description: body cites 'wetransfer.com' but the email was sent from 'we-transfer.com'
body cites 'wetransfer.com' but the email was sent from 'we-transfer.com'
